title: ep1.0_research_preview.md
part: ACT TWO · the regulate-me tour · sc 13-17
variant: stick-figure dialogue reel v2 · the recorded takes over a temp bed
logline: Act Two for flow and dialogue: the fastrec takes laid to the script's shots, one beat per shot. Stick figures and text cards stand in for the picture.

_source.script: show/episodes/ep01/script.md ## ACT TWO (the Act Two fixer pass, 2026-09-27)

beats.frame: WIDE · the meeting room
beats.caption: Portraits, a long table. Blocks A and I at the head; a teacher with a pointer and a CZAR? lanyard. The row faces her like a class.

seq.place: The White House: a meeting room

cues: music: MM-19 (THE PODIUM palette), light chamber pomp from the first frame · thins under the lines (temp: a B-flat chamber pad; the render has only the Fountain Pen)

beats.frame: MCU · SIRRAH at the blocks
beats.caption: The pointer lands on each block in turn.

lines.text: What can be, unburdened by what has been… trained.

beats.frame: MCU · 2-TONE freeze + card
beats.caption: The pointer lands on I: the world freezes for 1 beat under her card.
cues: style: 2-TONE freeze, 1 beat · then the card rides the live room for the rest of its bar

beats.frame: MCU · the card rides
beats.caption: The room moves again; the card rides to the end of its bar.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · RADNUS + MARIO (held; SIRRAH O.S.)
beats.caption: Radnus writes it down. Mario's finger goes fully up. On his last word the scroll in his pocket unrolls a foot onto the floor, on its own.

lines.text: Any questions, before we take the picture?
I have one concern.
Is it just the one?
It has sub-concerns. I've grouped them by how worried we should be.

beats.frame: WIDE · the photographer and three tripods
beats.caption: A White House photographer (back to us) sets a camera on a tripod. Then a second. Then a third, taped 1, 2, 3.

lines.text: Big smiles, please. Eyes on camera one.

beats.frame: MCU · a pan along the row, R→L (no cut, no zoom)
beats.caption: Tasya looks at camera 3; Mario at 2; Radnus at the ceiling's security camera. It settles on Mas: he looks straight at us, 1 beat.
cues: style: the episode's one lens look (pupils centred, 1 beat); everywhere else his pupils sit 1 px toward the speaker

beats.frame: WIDE · the photographer's wide
beats.caption: Three tripods, four people, four wrong eyelines.

lines.text: Camera one. Anyone.
We own camera two.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · MAS + RADNUS (held)
beats.caption: Radnus leans across to him, a small flame on his collar he hasn't noticed.

lines.text: Congratulations on your launch, Mas. Really. Everyone's using it.
thank you.
They ask it the things they used to ask us. And it tells them what a great question it was.
how's the dancing?

beats.frame: INSERT · the flame on Radnus's collar
beats.caption: The flame grows one size. His hand pats at it.

lines.text: We're being thoughtful.

beats.frame: WIDE · the door behind the row
beats.caption: The door opens. A man strides in mid-sentence, aviators up, a fountain pen like a baton. Three heads turn to him, each at its own speed. Mas's doesn't.

lines.text: Folks, I just want to say one thing.

cues: music: NEDIB's Fountain Pen motif (muted trumpet) takes MM-19 over on the door

beats.frame: WIDE · FLASH: all three cameras fire
beats.caption: All three cameras fire on the turned heads; the flash's freeze is the card's (1 beat).
cues: style: the flash is a white step (<= 80 %), and its freeze is the card's
style: 2-TONE freeze, 1 beat · then the card rides the live room for the rest of its bar

beats.frame: OTS · from behind Mario's raised finger onto NEDIB (held)
beats.caption: The card rides off. In the foreground Mario's finger goes all the way up; his other hand pulls the scroll out of his pocket.

lines.text: Whatever you promise in here today, put it in writing. Longer.
How much longer?
Longer than that. I've got a big desk.

beats.frame: INSERT · the print (meter G13)
beats.caption: Three CEOs twisted toward a door; a president half in frame; the blocks restacked I A; and Mas, the only one looking at the lens. A yearbook.

lines.text: it's a good photo.

cues: music: MM-19 rings out on the photo

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas's shoulder at the dark window
beats.caption: A clip on the phone in his hand: an invented anchor whose mouth lands a beat after a too-smooth voice; under it the app's grey tag, ALTERED AUDIO. Beyond the glass: the skyline, one lit window.

seq.place: NopeAI bullpen, the window → the bay

cues: sound: NO SCORE · the bullpen through glass, the phone's small speaker (the anchor's too-smooth murmur, no words: a made formant voice in the Act Two stem), then water on pilings

beats.frame: WIDE · the bay (push 1 of 3)
beats.caption: The water, the dark skyline, the one lit window small in the middle.

beats.frame: WIDE · the building, its lit window (push 2 of 3)
beats.caption: A silhouette with a phone (flash 7's shape). The same clip, and its tag, on its screen; it nods on the audio's beat, not the mouth's.

beats.frame: INSERT · a thumb on a repost arrow (push 3 of 3)
beats.caption: A thumb presses repost, just under the ALTERED AUDIO tag. Click.

beats.frame: WIDE · the lit window, the bay
beats.caption: A single hailstone drops from the lit window into the bay. Plink (the cold open's). The phone's glow clicks off. The silhouette doesn't move.

beats.frame: BLACK · the match cut on the voice
beats.caption: The too-smooth voice runs on over black and becomes the hearing's first words.

lines.text: "Too often we have seen what happens when technology outpaces regulation…"

beats.frame: MCU · the voice finds a mouth
beats.caption: A man at the microphone, glossy, a 1-px highlight on his hair, reading with perfect cadence.
cues: music: MM-20 Under Oath (PROCEDURE) from the first frame · thins to a pedal, ducks under every real line
style (proposed, style-range pass): THE CLONE alone through a too-clean upscale filter (AA edges, soft sheen); the chairman stays BASE; never toward photoreal · default: a 1-px highlight

beats.frame: WIDE · the hearing room
beats.caption: The dais, a gallery of identical spectators, the witness table. The matte chairman, identical to the clone, nods along, moved.

lines.text: Couldn't have said it better myself.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the chairman + THE CLONE
beats.caption: The clone gives him a look. He didn't. He takes the microphone back; they sit, the clone at his left hand. The clone keeps the better chair.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · MAS + SUCRAM · 2-TONE freeze + card
beats.caption: The witness table: Mas, and beside him a man with a binder, a stamp and a pad, already typing.
cues: style: 2-TONE freeze, 1 beat · then the card rides the live room for the rest of its bar

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · MAS + SUCRAM (held)
beats.caption: Sucram types, low, to Mas, not looking up.

lines.text: Don't mind me. It's a thread. One of forty-seven.
which one am i?
Most of them.

beats.frame: MCU · the chairman, reading from a card
beats.caption: He reads it from a card.

lines.text: "You may have had in mind the effect on jobs, which is really my biggest nightmare in the long term."

beats.frame: OTS · from behind Mas onto the dais (held)
beats.caption: On Mas's last word the chairman reaches for his next card; the clone takes it out of his hand and reads it for him. Nobody remarks on it.

lines.text: "gtp-4 and other systems like it are good at doing tasks, not jobs."
Are you nervous, Mr. Manalt?

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · MAS + SUCRAM · HOLD 1 BEAT
beats.caption: Mas sips his water. The dais waits (1 beat).

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the dais: chairman + clone
beats.caption: The chairman's eyes are on his card, in the clone's hand. The clone turns its head to him a beat late as he answers.

lines.text: Speaking for myself, a little.

beats.frame: WIDE · the dais leans in; a red light
beats.caption: One microphone's red light comes on; Mas's eyeline goes to it. A senator speaks from behind it.

lines.text: Mr. Manalt. There's talk of a new agency to regulate all this. Would you come and run it?

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · MAS + SUCRAM (held through the next question)
beats.caption: Beside him, Sucram types faster. On "money", Mas's hand goes to his pocket.

lines.text: "i love my current job."
You love it. Do you make a lot of money doing it?

beats.frame: INSERT · the wallet
beats.caption: He opens his wallet: one card. A tiny moth flies out in three drawings and lands on Sucram's stamp pad.
cues: music: MM-20 STOPS on the wallet (the act's deliberate stop) · the room's air only

beats.frame: WIDE · the wallet held up to the dais
beats.caption: Mas holds the open wallet up to the dais and says nothing. The gallery gasps: one held drawing. The clone leans to its mic.

lines.text: Health insurance.

onscreen.text: RAIL: TESTIFIES HE HAS NO EQUITY

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · MAS + SUCRAM
beats.caption: Sucram stamps furiously, the moth dodging. A red light comes on at another microphone, frame right.

lines.text: That proves nothing. Partially.
Is there anything you'd like this committee to do?

cues: music: MM-20 back on a new phrase

beats.frame: HIGH · the witness table from above
beats.caption: Mas slides one signed sheet toward the dais. Sucram stamps it mid-slide. It leaves frame right.

beats.frame: WIDE · the dais (a match on action)
beats.caption: The sheet arrives from frame left into the clone's hand. The senators lean in, delighted, turn it over to sign it, and hold its back up.

beats.frame: INSERT · the back of the sheet
beats.caption: Already stamped, in the same red.

beats.frame: MCU · SUCRAM stares
beats.caption: He stares at it. CUT on the stare.

beats.frame: GFX · the tour poster (held: ITEMS 1-4, the stamps pile up)
beats.caption: One concert-style poster, cities in a column, his face smiling 1 px. ITEM 1: a newsprint strip slaps on (printed, never voiced), EU gets a red stamp. ITEM 2: a hand in a silver cuff stamps "blackmail". ITEM 3: his post pops up; UN-CANCELLED lands over the first stamp. ITEM 4: the last date slot stamps itself.

onscreen.text: "…cease operating…" — MAS MANALT, ON THE EU'S DRAFT AI RULES

cues: music: MM-03 The Regulate-Me Tour (THE RUN), in on the first stamp's thunk · knee stab on every stamp

beats.frame: GFX·detail · the poster's photo
beats.caption: Cut in on the poster's photo of him: the one-pixel smile, held to the bar's end. No blink, no line.

beats.frame: WIDE · the table under the sky (phrase 1)
beats.caption: One sheet on a long table; the statement types across the top. Signers in swaps: one moves a chess piece no one can see; one in Godfather light; Mas in one stroke; Mario, who keeps the pen.

onscreen.text: "Mitigating the risk of extinction from AI should be a global priority…"

cues: music: MM-03 rings out into a held pad under the statement (no comic scoring on the record) · holds under the talk

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · MAS + MARIO at the sheet (held)
beats.caption: Mario writes under his name, the pen tight. Mas holds out his hand for it. Mario keeps writing.

lines.text: It's one sentence. It doesn't say what it costs.
So I'm adding a footnote. A short one.
we'll read it.
It has an appendix.

beats.frame: WIDE · a cash register rolls in (phrase 2)
beats.caption: A brass register rolls in on its own. Behind it, arms spread, a man in a leather jacket.
cues: music: MM-05 The More You Buy (THE JOB) in with the register · through phrase 3

beats.frame: WIDE · 2-TONE freeze + card
beats.caption: The register stops; the world freezes under his card for 1 beat.
cues: style: 2-TONE freeze, 1 beat · then the card rides the live room for the rest of its bar

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · MAS + MARIO turn to him
beats.caption: The pen still in Mario's hand, Mas's hand still half out for it; they turn to him.

lines.text: Can we help you? This is the extinction table.

beats.frame: OTS · from behind Mario onto NESNEJ at the register
beats.caption: To the signers, like a gift. (The real line keeps its dateline under the subtitle.)

lines.text: "The more you buy, the more you save."

beats.frame: INSERT · one key (phrase 3)
beats.caption: He presses one key. KA-CHING: the register's bell starts its long decay (it carries the act-out).

beats.frame: LEDGER · flash-print
beats.caption: The ledger flash-prints the figure (6 frames in the script; 12 in the stick reel, its shortest beat).
cues: style: [LEDGER] flash-print, 6 frames · then the figure holds in the register window (BASE)

beats.frame: INSERT · the register's window
beats.caption: The figure holds in the register window to read.

beats.frame: INSERT · the pen in Mario's hand
beats.caption: The signing pen in Mario's hand is now, somehow, a purchase order: for AI chips, quantity "more".

beats.frame: WIDE · the crack in the sky (phrase 4)
beats.caption: A hairline crack runs across the blue sky, L→R, in 12 frames. Everyone looks up: Nesnej, Mario (who writes it down), Mas last. Then Mas alone looks down at his glass.
cues: music: score drops out · the register's bell (rung by KA-CHING) decays over rooftop wind · no sting (the act's out)

beats.frame: INSERT · Mas's glass (the act-out)
beats.caption: The crack in the water; the water doesn't move. The reflected crack keeps going after the sky's has stopped, until it runs across his small reflection.
cues: style: in the water the reflected crack runs on after the sky's has stopped (whole-pixel steps) until it crosses his small reflection · fallback if the room reads it as a UI wink (L8): the plain insert

beats.frame: BLACK · on the bell's last partial
beats.caption: CUT TO BLACK. (The recommended 11-minute split point.)
